reviews.text: I have nothing but goof things to say about Fox Veterinary Clinic.  I have multiple pets and fosters so lots of visits for many different cats and dogs, but always the same friendly welcome, kindness and expertise. My oldest dog can't resist getting in there for a visit,  even if there's nothing wrong, she loves being there and actively tries to get in every time we pass by.
Staff is always very friendly and helpful. Felix is happy to go in for a visit- maybe more excited when he leaves😁

I had my poor  dog ' Danny" put to sleep  on the 12 th June 2026. after falling  down the stairs  that morning.
I was very very upset   as this all happened  so suddenly.
Michael  John put 'Danny ' to sleep.
I found  him to be so so cold, not one word of compassion  or sympathy.
He cannot  look  you in the eye.
After Danny  was put  to sleep  ,a lady ? her name ,pushed a paying  machine  in front of  me  ,and never  spoke a word to me.
It left a very bad memory  for me even now ,afte almost  .4 months.
They were to send me on ' foot print ' of his paws ,but not a word.
I will  never  return to this place  again.
Mary Mc Donald

I love my dog Teddy beyond words. I compare my love for Teddy the sane for my son unconditional.Like my son Teddy cannot see my flaws and he does not judge me. If I locked Teddy and my wife in the boot of the car for 8 hrs and opened the boot Teddy would be excited to see me. My wife loves Teddy too as she says she loves the bones if him. He brings more to us than we do to him. So when he is not well there is only one place we trust and that is the Fox Veterinary team. We trust them with our lives because Teddy is our lives he is our saviour. His eye look into our souls and and feeds us with love. The Fox team treat us as if we were the only dog owners in the world and they reassure us constantly and are so nice to Teddy and that is paramount and they too think of Teddy and any other patient they get in as special and treat them all with compassion. If got live close to these guys and own a special friend in your life these are the guys to go to. Oh and not forgetting the groomer they are amazing too.Everyone associated with Fox treat the business as if they owned it, they are all motivated people.

I started going to fox's vets over 24 years ago when we had our cat Salem. When Michael took over the practice we had a new addition to our family, Bonnie another beautiful cat. Over the years we attended the practice on numerous occasions, whether it was just for the normal vaccinations and check ups or for more serious medical assistance for our two beauties.
Salem reached the ripe old age of 18 and when it was her time to go, Michael helped her on her journey with the most empathetic and heartfelt attitude, although heartbreaking for us, he made this journey a little easier
On Sunday evening 5th July our baby Bonnie had a stroke, I contacted Michael out of hours and didn't expect a reply, but he did respond, he texted me in the early hours of the morning, guiding us and giving us the advice we needed.
Yesterday morning he came to our home and again assisted with putting her to sleep and out of her misery. She died peacefully in our arms at the age of 14.
Although we are now a cat less family for the first time in 24 years and devastated, Michael did help make this a little easier. It is not just a job to him but a true vocation and we will never forget his professionalism and pure kindness throughout this sad time.
Thank you Michael and the whole team for being there for us through good times and bad. We will be forever grateful.
Maria, Vittorio and Kerrie ❤️

I seriously cannot thank the staff in Fox’s surgery enough. We had to have our dog put to sleep last week after a diagnosis of cancer. The staff were just exceptional from start to finish in what was a terribly upsetting time. Thankyou so very much for all your kindness! 🩷 Ruby’s mam …

I'm not happy with the ignore. I asked.
I called, they were supposed to call me back because my cat was sick, but they didn't call, and they didn't provide any information.
They took an ear swab the next day. They took another swab because the first one didn't work, but I had to call twice.
I asked for an email about what happened to the cat, no response, but you know how to take money.
Incredible service from this vets as always! Can’t recommend them enough
MJ is at the top of his game! Great service and they helped save my Rocco when he swallowed a small beanie ball!
Disgraceful. Money seekers. Went there with my cat and came back in a worse condition

Been going to Fox vet for year, staff are always friendly and helpful, the vets always explain situations clearly and as my 2 dogs are very old, they explain the pro’s and con’s of treatment, I had to have my much loved staffie put to sleep recently and the staff were just brilliant, kind and caring. Vet’s are like any other service, people will love it or not, but I have no hesitation recommending Fox Vet to family & Friends.
Great place. Highly recommend, so friendly!!
Absolutely fantastic, only discovered them recently, my dog was dying, he was handled with utmost care and dignity. Wish I’d known them years ago. Many thanks.
Great staff working tirelessly hard here, with little to no appreciation from some within Ireland. Keep up the great work everyone. 💕 …

Highly recommended. Such a lovely warm clinic. Really welcoming and patient. Treated my dog really fast and efficiently. Listened and very gentle. Thank you so much for seeing her. Excellent clinic with a very caring team.
Dr. Dermond genuinely loves animals, you can literally see it in his eyes. He fixed our boy Levy’s tonsillitis, Levy trusted him from the start, and we’ll definitely be back ❤️

I cannot recommend fox vets enough! Especially Lindsay! Bringing my baby gypsy into the vets has always been a scary experience for me and her both but Lindsay was absolutely amazing at putting us both and ease and answering the million and one questions I had. All of our appointments have been with Lindsay as with her I seen how comfortable gypsy was, and I knew she was in safe hands. From our first appointment to our last the staff and Lindsay were absolute gems. Words can't express how thankful I am. Lindsay thank you so much for the love and care you've shown!
